name: Echo Show 5 3rd Gen (US)

radios.note: No official page we could read states this model's radios (Amazon's product pages refuse automated reading). Amazon's Zigbee and Thread docs do not list it.

matter.note: Amazon's May 2023 launch release says the new Echo Show 5 supports Matter, and Amazon's Matter docs list Echo Show 5 (1st Gen and newer) as Matter-enabled, with the Echo as the Matter administrator. No CSA listing naming this model was found, so a certificate is not confirmed.

apple_home.note: No official source shows devices paired through this Echo Show appearing in Apple Home.

google_home.note: No official source shows devices paired through this Echo Show appearing in Google Home.

alexa.note: An Alexa device itself: Amazon lists Echo Show 5 (1st Gen and newer) as Matter-enabled, with the Echo as the Matter administrator that connects Matter devices to Alexa locally. Matter-over-Thread devices need a Thread border router, and this model is not on Amazon's list of them.

smartthings.note: No official source shows devices paired through this Echo Show appearing in SmartThings.

home_assistant.note: No official Home Assistant page shows Echo-paired devices appearing there.

hubRequired.note: The Echo Show is itself the Alexa device that controls Matter accessories.

localControl.note: Amazon says connecting a device directly over Matter lets Alexa control it locally. This applies to Matter devices, not to every device.

hubType.note: A compact Alexa display that acts as the Matter administrator for Alexa. Amazon doesn't list it as a Zigbee hub.

deviceProtocols.note: Not confirmed. The Echo Show 5 is not on Amazon's lists of Echo devices with a Zigbee hub or a Thread border router.

matterBridge.note: Amazon's Matter docs don't name any Echo as a Matter bridge.

threadBorderRouter.note: Not on Amazon's Thread border router list. A list that leaves it out does not say it lacks one, so this stays unconfirmed.

maxDevices.note: No limit found in the sources.

summary: Amazon's docs list the Echo Show 5 (3rd Gen) as Matter-enabled, so this small Alexa display acts as the Matter administrator and controls Matter devices locally. It is not on Amazon's lists of Zigbee hubs or Thread border routers. Support for other ecosystems isn't confirmed.
caveats: Not on Amazon's lists of Zigbee hubs or Thread border routers, so plan on another Echo, an eero or a border router for Zigbee devices and Matter over Thread.
Amazon's Matter docs say 'Echo Show 5 (1st Gen and newer)' rather than naming the 3rd Gen, and no CSA listing was found.
